external_games.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - KAGAMINE RIN, KAGAMINE LEN Pack

name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len Pack
summary:
KAGAMINE RIN, KAGAMINE LEN Pack contains 3 songs: "Lavie", "The Lost One's Weeping" and "1,2, Fanclub".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass. This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.
